mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_info (info_id, member_email, info_name, trip_place, start_date, end_date, who_tag, style_tag) VALUES (info_id_seq.NEXTVAL, #{member_email}, #{info_name}, #{trip_place}, #{start_date}, #{end_date}, #{who_tag}, #{style_tag})
mapper.select: SELECT tp.plan_day, tp.plan_seq, a.attr_name FROM travel_plan tp JOIN attr a ON tp.attr_id = a.attr_id WHERE tp.info_id = #{infoId} ORDER BY tp.plan_day, tp.plan_seq

WITH date_range AS ( SELECT TO_DATE('2024-08-21', 'YYYY-MM-DD') + LEVEL - 1 AS day FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= (TO_DATE('2024-09-02', 'YYYY-MM-DD') - TO_DATE('2024-08-21', 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1) ) SELECT TO_CHAR(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS formatted_day FROM date_range

WITH filtered_info AS ( SELECT INFO_ID, STYLE_TAG, TRIP_PLACE, WHO_TAG, INFO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY INFO_ID) AS rn FROM TRAVEL_INFO WHERE TRIM(STYLE_TAG) LIKE '%' || #{style} || '%' ) SELECT * FROM filtered_info WHERE rn BETWEEN #{offset} + 1 AND #{offset} + #{pageSize}

WITH filtered_info AS ( SELECT INFO_ID, WHO_TAG, TRIP_PLACE, STYLE_TAG, INFO_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY INFO_ID) AS rn FROM TRAVEL_INFO WHERE WHO_TAG LIKE '%' || #{who} || '%' ) SELECT * FROM filtered_info WHERE rn BETWEEN #{offset} + 1 AND #{offset} + #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRAVEL_INFO WHERE STYLE_TAG LIKE '%' || #{style} || '%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRAVEL_INFO WHERE WHO_TAG LIKE '%' || #{who} || '%'
